_note: Wand body materials. P/C/R/S/Cn on a 1-10 scale (Potency, Capacity, Recharge, Stability, Conductivity). bite = damage multiplier by target category (missing = 1.0). sockets = spine sockets when used as a shaft; flankChance = chance a gap has a flank socket. velocity/tempo default to the family values in families.

materials.name: Willow
materials.quirk: Bends: shots curve slightly toward your aim drift, easy to steer

materials.name: Ironbark Oak
materials.quirk: Almost never overloads; slow tempo

materials.name: Ashen Yew
materials.quirk: Graveyard wood; each kill briefly doubles recharge

materials.name: Emberpine
materials.quirk: Resin ignites when overheated: overloads become fire bursts instead of misfires

materials.name: Hollowreed
materials.quirk: Many sockets, tiny reservoir; a fast, fiddly build wand

materials.name: Knotwood
materials.quirk: One random knot socket per wand that doubles its crystal's effect (lab: the 2nd socket is the knot)

materials.name: Copper
materials.quirk: Perfect conductor; high resonance, so feedback loops run hot

materials.name: Cold Iron
materials.quirk: Shots break magic shields; poor conductor, best with 1-2 crystals

materials.name: Silver
materials.quirk: Twice as strong at night, half at noon

materials.name: Gold
materials.quirk: Hoarder: huge reservoir, slow refill

materials.name: Star-iron
materials.quirk: Meteoric; socket count random per wand (lab: 4), flank spots common

materials.name: Quicksilver Rod
materials.quirk: Liquid metal in glass: crystals slosh; tilting while firing swaps two neighbors

materials.name: Obsidian
materials.quirk: Glass-sharp, brutal damage, cracks easily

materials.name: Basalt
materials.quirk: Roots you: +50% recharge standing still, nothing while moving

materials.name: Lodestone
materials.quirk: Magnetic: shots curve toward armored targets

materials.name: Chalk
materials.quirk: Cheap starter; shots leave marks that later shots home in on

materials.name: Geode
materials.quirk: Crack it open (permanent) to reveal a hidden inner socket that affects every crystal

materials.name: Wolf Femur
materials.quirk: Pack: +15% recharge per ally or companion near you

materials.name: Bird Hollowbone
materials.quirk: Fastest shots in the game

materials.name: Whalebone
materials.quirk: Shots carry a deep pulse that knocks targets back

materials.name: Antler
materials.quirk: Self-repairs; grows a new socket each in-game spring

materials.name: Dragon Rib
materials.quirk: Legendary; fire crystals in it count double

materials.name: Saint's Knuckle
materials.quirk: Relic; harmful spells only on the dead and on wards

materials.name: Clear Quartz
materials.quirk: Every modifier crystal +20%

materials.name: Amethyst
materials.quirk: Calm stone: backlash from overloads is halved

materials.name: Prismglass
materials.quirk: Every shot also splits a weak copy off each side

materials.name: Rime Crystal
materials.quirk: Melts in heat: loses Stability near fire, freezes Water shots into ice

materials.name: Rock Salt
materials.quirk: Purifying; slowly dissolves if used in rain or with Water crystals

materials.name: Living Coral
materials.quirk: Alive: grows new sockets if kept in water; dies if left dry too long

materials.name: Amber (with insect)
materials.quirk: Memory: every 5th shot replays the previous shot for free

materials.name: Nautilus Shell
materials.quirk: Spiral spine: the last socket feeds back into the first (built-in loop)

materials.name: Thornvine
materials.quirk: Huge power and recharge, paid in your health

materials.name: Fulgurite
materials.quirk: Lightning-made glass; only fully charges during storms

materials.name: Dreamwood
materials.quirk: Shows a ghost preview of the next shot's shape before you fire
